text:
maya (PM): quick gap-scan before we hand off GA package. want a tight checklist: SLA targets, monitoring + alerts, support runbooks, pricing backstops, and failover tests.
devin (SRE): agree. what SLA numbers are we committing to in the docs? p95/p99/availability?
maya (PM): target p95 <= 150ms, p99 <= 400ms (non-burst), availability 99.95%. include explicit error-budget exhaustion behavior and commercial exception flow.
lucas (ProdOps): will validate capacity for reserved pools and burst lanes. need to prove fallback model route when we hit x3 traffic. I'll schedule failover run tomorrow morning.
rahul (FinOps): for pricing we should offer two pilot options: (A) burst credits with surcharge, (B) throttled soft-tier with discounted base rate. I'll prepare simple numbers and sensitivity to token mix.
emily (Support): need owners for runbooks: model-quality regression -> research oncall; latency/infra incidents -> infra oncall; billing disputes -> billing ops (rahul). also want an escalation matrix and canned responses.
anna (Docs): I'll produce runbook templates and quickstart examples (self-serve + enterprise onboarding). can someone drop expected token sizes and sample payloads?
maya (PM): sample payloads: conversation api avg 120 tokens, long-form 800 tokens. include cost calc examples for quantization/embedding flows.
devin (SRE): alert proposals: p95 > 150ms for 5m, p99 > 400ms for 5m, burn_rate > 2 for 1h. also synthetic checks: mixed short/long sequences to detect tail regressions.
lucas (ProdOps): Devin, add k8s CronJob synthetic runner and link to perf dashboard. run for 72h pre-GA. I'll run failover tests against reserved capacity and simulate region outage.
anna (Docs): will include an "SLA exceptions and commercial escalation" page with template contract language and example emails.
rahul (FinOps): adding pricing backstop clause: auto-throttle if burst > 3x sustained for 15m unless customer opted into burst credits. will draft wording for pilot contracts.
emily (Support): draft incident playbooks: 1) latency spike: immediate mitigation steps + customer comms; 2) quality regression: rollback path + data capture; 3) billing dispute: bill audit checklist.
oncall-bot: Notice: maintenance window - PagerDuty 2024-07-11 02:00-03:00 UTC.
maya (PM): action owners & due dates: SRE alerts + synthetic (devin) - EOD tomorrow; ProdOps capacity + failover run (lucas) - tomorrow AM; Docs runbooks + SLA language (anna) - EOD tomorrow; FinOps pricing options (rahul) - EOD; Support runbook owners + dry-run (emily) - schedule next week.
devin (SRE): I'll post draft dashboard + alert rules link once up.
lucas (ProdOps): scheduling failover, will attach results to the runbook PR.
rahul (FinOps): uploading a simple spreadsheet with two pricing scenarios and sensitivity to avg token length.
anna (Docs): will open PRs: /docs/ga/quickstart.md, /docs/ga/sla.md, /docs/ga/runbooks.md. will include examples and templates.
emily (Support): planning a 30m dry-run with oncall next Wed. will circulate invite.
maya (PM): last ask: include rollback criteria and customer notification templates in the GA package. reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT for final go/no-go.
all: :thumbsup:
